scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-ports.mjs && pnpm --filter @bht/shared build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter @bht/shared --filter @bht/api --filter @bht/web dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bht/shared build && pnpm --filter @bht/api build && pnpm --filter @bht/web build
scripts.build:api: npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build -- --webpack && node apps/web/scripts/prepare-standalone.mjs
